results.content: Mistral gave its flagship the nickname Le Chonk and shipped it in two steps. A public preview arrived in October 2026, and open weights followed on October 29. The preview version has since been retired and the October 29 release is the active model, so anyone still pointing at preview weights should move. The model is natively multimodal, with roughly 1 trillion total parameters and about 49 billion active, and Mistral positions it for agentic coding and cybersecurity work. [...] Five open-weight model families dominate the November 2026 conversation: Kimi K3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Mistral Large 4, GLM-5.3 and Gemma 4. They share a label and almost nothing else. Mistral publishes a named license (the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, which Mistral describes as a modified MIT license), while a third-party comparison of open-weight licenses flags that several rivals need a closer read of the model card before you ship anything on top of them. [...] Mistral and NVIDIA on engineering workflows (October 21, 2026). Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA on AI-native engineering, using Mistral Large 4 alongside simulation and physics pipelines and NVIDIA accelerated computing. Neil Ashton, identified as Mistral’s VP of Computational Engineering, appears in the announcement. Lesson: open weights let an industrial buyer keep sensitive design data inside its own simulation stack.

results.title: Mistral Large 4: Open Weights, License, Price, Benchmarks
results.content:
AI News

# Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks

By Lenka Vojtechova  ·  Updated November 7, 2026  ·  12 min read

AI NewsMistralOpen-Source ModelLLMAI Coding

Thumbnail reading [...] Thumbnail reading 

Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. Mistral AI released it as a public preview API on October 6, 2026, then shipped an improved final version and the open weights on October 29. It reads text and images, answers in text, and now costs $0.70 per million input tokens. [...] Yes. Mistral released the weights on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, two days after the date it gave reporters. They cover the improved final model, and come with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. The licence is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT licence.

 

How much does Mistral Large 4 cost?

$0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.07, since October 29, 2026. The preview listed at $1.36 and $4.18.

results.title: Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform
results.content:
On 20 October 2026, Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership that involves Mistral in building the group's AI platform, beyond access to its models: an agent for retail banking clients, agentic processes, and cybersecurity, presented as "a major focus". The announcements from BNP Paribas and HSBC, already partners of Mistral, do not mention cybersecurity. The announcement sets no amount, duration, model, or exclusivity.

STStephane Nachez · ·4 min [...] The 20 October release cites three workstreams: a conversational agent for clients of the group's retail banks, the "agentic transformation of key processes", and cybersecurity. Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence runs the group's AI foundations. With Mistral's technology, it also plans to adapt large language models to its data and use cases. The release sees this as a way to optimise performance, "and therefore the consumption of computing resources and its environmental impact". [...] The 20 October release gives no amount, no commitment duration, no timeline for the client agent, and cites no particular Mistral model. It also says nothing about any exclusivity. The pattern recalls that observed with Mistral at EDF, BMW, or Airbus: partnerships announced, rarely quantified. The announcement comes six weeks after the lab's 3 billion euro fundraising.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search recent news on the web. Returns titles, URLs and snippets.

message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Launch of Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"):** Mistral officially released its flagship 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (with ~49B active parameters) on October 29, 2026, following a public preview phase [[1]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026). The model features native multimodality, NVFP4 checkpoints for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, and is available under the "Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License" (a modified MIT license) [[1]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026), [[2]](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4).
* **Enterprise & Sovereign Partnerships:** 
  * **Crédit Agricole:** Partnered with Mistral on October 20, 2026, to develop a group AI platform focused on retail banking conversational agents, agentic business processes, and cybersecurity [[3]](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform).
  * **Orange Cyberdefense:** Named a design partner for cybersecurity on November 2, 2026, integrating Mistral Large 4 into penetration testing, technical security assessments, and incident response [[4]](https://mspbusiness.com/en/market-and-strategy/orange-cyberdefense-becomes-mistral-ai-design-partner-for-cybersecurity).
  * **NVIDIA Collaboration:** Announced an engineering workflow integration on October 21, 2026, coupling Mistral Large 4 with physics simulation pipelines for industrial workloads [[1]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026).
* **Financial Position:** The announcements follow a massive €3 billion Series D funding round closed in September 2026 [[3]](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform], [5].

## Talking points
* **Adoption of Mistral Large 4:** Inquire about early enterprise feedback on "Le Chonk," particularly how clients are leveraging its agentic coding and cybersecurity capabilities [[1]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026).
* **Sovereign & Regulated Verticals:** Discuss how the partnerships with Orange Cyberdefense and Crédit Agricole position Mistral to capture banking and critical infrastructure sectors requiring local compliance and data residency [[3]](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform], [4].
* **Monetization and Cost Efficiency:** Review the competitive pricing structure introduced with Mistral Large 4 ($0.70/M input tokens, $2.10/M output tokens) and how caching ($0.07) impacts enterprise unit economics [[2]](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4).

## Open questions
* How are enterprise clients navigating the specific terms of the *Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License* compared to standard MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses when deploying commercial derivatives?
* What are the deployment hurdles for scaling a 1-trillion-parameter MoE model (like Le Chonk) on-premise versus leveraging API endpoints?
* Following the €3 billion Series D raise, what are Mistral's core geographic expansion priorities outside of Europe?

## Sources
* [Open Source AI Models: 3 Run Paths, 48% Index [2026]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026)
* [Mistral Large 4: Open Weights, License, Price, Benchmarks](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4)
* [Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform)
* [Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI design partner for cybersecurity – MSP Business](https://mspbusiness.com/en/market-and-strategy/orange-cyberdefense-becomes-mistral-ai-design-partner-for-cybersecurity)
